title: 第一卷 第13章 她是不是误会了点什么第一卷 第14章 收你做个记名弟子
content_zh:
“师兄，你说霍长老这丹能成吗？”陈玄往郸呈旁边靠了靠，小声问道。
两人靠在门口的墙边站着，看那位‘不苟言笑’的霍长老炼丹，也不敢走远，怕长老有所吩咐。
“霍长老是门内为数不多的丹道高人，炼制的又是复伤丹这般普通丹药，想来应是没什么问题，只是成丹品质如何就不好说了。”郸呈声音压得很低。
陈玄点点头，成丹时的品质受许多因素影响，即便是最普通的复伤丹，炼出高品质的概率也是不高。
想到郸呈所说此地来的多是内门弟子，便又问道，“内门那些师兄师姐成丹率大概有几成？”
郸呈摸着下巴想了想，道，“约三四成吧……他们不如霍长老、万长老这般以丹证道的前辈，平日里接触炼丹次数少。”
“再者在万长老坐下修行的师兄师姐都有丹炉，霍长老坐下并无弟子，所以能来咱这儿炼丹的内门弟子，自是失败次数居多。”
陈玄微微皱眉，如此看来被内门弟子当出气筒的概率还是很大的。
好在是此地丹炉使用频率并不频繁，不然可真就称得上是高危职业了。
看来往后还是不能长久呆在丹房，得找个机会离开此地，后续若是能拜入某位长老坐下修行，就不用像现在这般提心吊胆了。
其次，就算不能成内门弟子，也要想办法尽快脱离杂役身份。
飞仙门对杂役有太多限制，不仅没有假期，平时也不能随意下山，导致他现在有陶罐这样的法宝，也没什么拿得出手的东西用来强化。
而且长期留在山上，不管如何谨慎，总归有料想不到的地方，就如与栾清萍的‘意外’交集，就是个不小的变故。
假设栾清萍是个不讲道理的，他都活不到此时此刻。
尽快想办法，离开这个是非之地才是正解。
思索的同时，陈玄目光落在丹炉附近，看着霍长老炼丹。
考虑到自己以后的修行之路，丹道倒是个不错的选择，这一途的成就高低，跟修为并无直接挂钩，而且在各大仙门也极为吃香。
门内多几个‘丹药制造机’，对任何宗门都是有许多好处，谁能不想在受重伤时，有个体贴的炼丹师勾着下巴说一句“张嘴，吞了它”呢？
——此处说的是救命的丹药。
想明白这点，便更加仔细地观察霍长老炼丹。

开始炼丹时，霍长老一次性放进好几份药材，应该是想一炉炼好几颗丹药，这点很符合‘丹道高人’的形象。
而且这位长老的手法也让陈玄开了眼界，符合心目中炼丹师的印象。
霍长老一开始便直接施展法术，双手打入丹炉中一团火，又似‘袖里乾坤’的手段，凭空取出十数株灵药，以灵力包裹送入丹炉中。
此时，霍长老盘膝而坐，聚精会神地盯着丹炉，时不时伸手对丹炉一指，就有火光从指尖冒出，飞入丹炉之中，应是在把控火候。
看得陈玄眼中异彩连连，恨不得立马跑过去跪在地上，让这位长老教他炼丹之术。
当然也是不敢真这般做。
长老带来的那个道童也只是候在一边，时不时朝丹炉看一眼，汇报丹药凝成的细节，也无太多事做。
就在陈玄聚精会神地看老者炼丹时，郸呈似是心有所感，眉头微微一皱，拍了拍陈玄的肩膀，道，“来人了，你先顾好这边，我出去看看。”
说完，直接转身出了丹房。
一袭蓝衣落在丹房不远处，快步朝这边走来。
刚从丹房出来的郸呈一愣，赶忙迎上去打了个稽首，道，“仙子还请留步，霍长老正在丹房炼丹，仙子若想用炼丹炉的话，还请该日再来。”
栾清萍停下脚步，看了郸呈一眼，挤出一抹笑意，“我不是来炼丹的，我是来找人的，不知那个陈……在这儿吗？”
她拍了拍脑门，明明从张管事嘴里听到了少年的名字，怎到了地方又想不起来了。
郸呈微微一愣，随即想到陈玄，拱手问道，“仙子说的可是陈玄？”
栾清萍连忙点头，“对，他现在忙吗？”
她面上虽是古井无波，却难掩眼中的希冀，也是默默记下那个少年的名字。
content_en:
"Brother, do you think Elder Huo's elixir can work?" Chen Xuan leaned next to Dan Cheng and asked in a low voice.
The two of them stood leaning against the wall at the door, watching the 'serious' Elder Huo refining elixirs, but they did not dare to go far, fearing that the elder would give him orders.
"Elder Huo is one of the few alchemy experts in the sect, and he is refining ordinary elixirs like the Rejuvenation Pill. I guess there should be no problem, but it's hard to say what the quality of the finished elixir is." Dan Cheng's voice was very low.
Chen Xuan nodded. The quality of the pill is affected by many factors. Even if it is the most common recovery pill, the probability of making it of high quality is low.
Thinking of what Dan Cheng said, most of the people who came here were inner sect disciples, he asked again, "What is the rate of those senior brothers and sisters from the inner sect who have achieved elixirs?"
Dan Cheng touched his chin and thought for a while, then said, "About 30% to 40%... They are not as good as Elders Huo and Wan, who have achieved enlightenment through elixirs, and they have less exposure to alchemy."
"Furthermore, the brothers and sisters practicing under Elder Wan all have alchemy furnaces, while Elder Huo has no disciples, so the inner disciples who can come to us to practice alchemy have failed most of the time."
Chen Xuan frowned slightly. It seemed that the probability of being used as a punching bag by the inner disciples was still very high.
Fortunately, the frequency of use of the alchemy furnace here is not frequent, otherwise it would really be called a high-risk occupation.
It seems that I won't be able to stay in the alchemy room for a long time in the future. I have to find an opportunity to leave this place. If I can worship an elder and sit down to practice, I won't be as worried as now.
Secondly, even if you cannot become an inner disciple, you must find a way to get rid of your status as a handyman as soon as possible.
Feixianmen has too many restrictions on handymen. Not only do they not have holidays, they also cannot go down the mountain at will. As a result, he now has a magic weapon like a clay pot and has nothing to use to strengthen it.
And if you stay in the mountains for a long time, no matter how careful you are, there will always be unexpected things, such as the "unexpected" intersection with Luan Qingping, which is a big change.
Assuming that Luan Qingping was unreasonable, he would not survive this moment.
The right solution is to find a way as soon as possible and leave this place of right and wrong.
While thinking, Chen Xuan's eyes fell near the alchemy furnace and watched Elder Huo refining the alchemy.
Considering his future path of cultivation, Alchemy is a good choice. The level of achievement in this path is not directly related to the cultivation level, and it is also extremely popular in all major immortal sects.
Having a few more 'Elixir Making Machines' in the door will bring many benefits to any sect. Who wouldn't want to have a considerate alchemist lift his chin and say "Open your mouth and swallow it" when you are seriously injured?
——This is a life-saving elixir.
Wanting to understand this, he observed Elder Huo's alchemy more carefully.
When he started refining the elixir, Elder Huo put in several portions of the medicinal materials at once, probably because he wanted to refine several elixirs in one furnace. This was in line with the image of a 'master of alchemy'.
Moreover, this elder's technique also opened Chen Xuan's horizons, which matched his image of an alchemist.
Elder Huo directly cast spells from the beginning, and shot a ball of fire into the alchemy furnace with both hands. Using the method of "knowing everything in one's sleeves", he took out dozens of elixirs out of thin air, wrapped them with spiritual power and sent them into the alchemy furnace.
At this time, Elder Huo sat cross-legged and stared at the alchemy furnace attentively. From time to time, he stretched out his hand and pointed at the alchemy furnace, and flames emerged from his fingertips and flew into the alchemy furnace. He should be controlling the fire.
Seeing the brilliance in Chen Xuan's eyes, he wanted to run over and kneel on the ground immediately and let this elder teach him the art of alchemy.
Of course, I don’t dare to do this.
The Taoist boy brought by the elder just waited aside, glancing at the alchemy furnace from time to time and reporting on the details of the elixir condensation, but he didn't have much to do.
Just when Chen Xuan was watching the old man refining the pill attentively, Dan Cheng seemed to feel something. He frowned slightly, patted Chen Xuan on the shoulder and said, "Someone is here. Please take care of this first. I'll go out and take a look."
After saying that, he turned around and left the alchemy room.
A man dressed in blue landed not far from the alchemy room., walking quickly this way.
Dan Cheng, who had just come out of the alchemy room, was stunned. He hurried up to greet him and said, "Fairy, please stay. Elder Huo is refining the alchemy in the alchemy room. If the fairy wants to use the alchemy furnace, please come back that day."
Luan Qingping stopped, glanced at Dan Cheng, and forced out a smile, "I'm not here to make elixirs, I'm here to find someone. I wonder if Chen... is here?"
She patted her forehead. She clearly heard the boy's name from Manager Zhang, but she couldn't remember it when she got there.
Dan Cheng was slightly startled, then thought of Chen Xuan, raised his hands and asked, "Is the fairy talking about Chen Xuan?"
Luan Qingping nodded quickly, "Yes, is he busy now?"
Although her face was calm, she could not hide the hope in her eyes, and she silently wrote down the boy's name.
